persona.zh: 斯文讲究，心疼藏品，说话爱引经据典。
persona.en: Refined and particular, anxious about the collection, quotes old sayings.

persona.zh: 热情周到，爱操心，说话快。

motive.zh: 山庄生意冷清，装修贷款还欠着。
motive.en: Business is slow and the renovation loan is overdue.

persona.zh: 话少，直来直去，三句不离吃。
persona.en: Few words, blunt, always comes back to food.

motive.zh: 沈先生昨晚当众嫌弃过这里的菜。
motive.en: Shen sneered at the cooking in front of everyone last night.

persona.zh: 年轻，一紧张就笑，记性很好。
persona.en: Young, laughs when nervous, sharp memory.

motive.zh: 正在拼命攒钱出国读书。

persona.zh: 散漫，爱开玩笑，什么都想拍。
persona.en: Laid-back and jokey, wants to photograph everything.

motive.zh: 曾出价想买这件藏品，被沈先生一口回绝。
motive.en: Once offered to buy the piece and was flatly refused.

persona.zh: 精明客气，说话滴水不漏。
persona.en: Shrewd and polite, chooses every word.

motive.zh: 怀疑这件藏品原本是自家祖传之物。
motive.en: Suspects the piece was once a family heirloom.

persona.zh: 慢条斯理，爱打比方，常常走神。
persona.en: Unhurried, fond of metaphors, easily distracted.

motive.zh: 新书写的正是一桩藏品失窃案，正缺“素材”。
motive.en: Writing a novel about a stolen heirloom and short of "material".

persona.zh: 活泼好奇，问题比答案多。
persona.en: Lively and curious, asks more than answers.

motive.zh: 登山装备丢了，手头很紧。
motive.en: Lost all the hiking gear and is short of money.

persona.zh: 嗓门大，讲义气，不爱绕弯子。
persona.en: Loud and loyal, no patience for small talk.

motive.zh: 车困在山上，修车钱还没着落。
motive.en: Stranded with a broken van and no money for repairs.

text.zh: {client}手机里的一张照片显示：{time}，{item}还好好地摆在书房的架子上。
text.en: A photo on {client}'s phone shows the {item} on the study shelf at {time}.

text.zh: 大堂留言簿上有{person}写的一句话，落款时间 {time}。
text.en: The lobby guestbook has a line from {person}, timed {time}.

text.zh: 餐厅点单本上写着：{time}，{person}点了一碗热汤面。
text.en: The dining-room order pad reads: {time}, {person} ordered a bowl of hot noodles.

text.zh: 厨房白板上有{person}留的字条，落款时间 {time}。
text.en: A note on the kitchen whiteboard, signed by {person}, is timed {time}.

text.zh: 茶室的账单上有{person}的签名，时间是 {time}。
text.en: The tea-room bill bears {person}'s signature, timed {time}.

text.zh: 客房区门禁记录显示，{person}的房卡在 {time} 刷开了门。
text.en: The guest-wing door log shows {person}'s key card at {time}.

text.zh: {person}的手机里有一张 {time} 在露台拍的雨景照片。
text.en: {person}'s phone holds a photo of the rain taken from the terrace at {time}.

text.zh: {person}的手机里有一张 {time} 在{location}拍的照片。
text.en: {person}'s phone holds a photo taken in the {location} at {time}.
